content.text:
**Recommended model:** keep one full-page crop, then attach optional stem/option image crops as separate assets, and tag each question with chapter + subtopic (multi-label OK). That matches your VT-graph case and the topic query use case.

---

## What each MC actually contains

From the segmented `output/<year>/qN.png` crops, questions fall into a few media patterns:

| Pattern | Example | What to store |
|---|---|---|
| Stem text + stem diagram + text options | 2024 Q1 (heating curves) | statement, stem image, 4 text options |
| Stem diagram + text + **graph options A–D** | ripple-tank reflection (2024 Q15) | statement, stem image, 4 option images (text often empty) |
| Stem figure(s) + text options | 2024 Q16 (slinky wave) | statement, stem image(s), 4 text options |
| Text only | many kinematics/circuits | statement + 4 text options |

Today you only have the full crop. For “which VT graph is correct?”, you later crop each option graph into `A/B/C/D` assets and keep the full page as the review image.

---

## Possible schemas (3 options)

### A. Flat document (closest to current OCR JSON)
One row/document per question: statement, options map, one PNG path, topics array.

- Pros: simple, matches `mc_questions.json`
- Cons: hard to query “all Radiation option-graphs”, no clean place for per-option crops

### B. Normalized relational (recommended)
Separate `questions`, `options`, `assets`, `topics`, `question_topics`.

- Pros: first-class images, multi-topic, easy “give me Radiation / Photoelectric” queries
- Cons: more tables / joins

### C. Hybrid JSONB (Postgres)
Normalized question + options, but media/metadata as JSONB.

- Pros: flexible while still queryable by topic
- Cons: weaker constraints on option/image shape

**Go with B** unless you specifically want a document store.

---

## Recommended schema (lavish ER view)

```mermaid
erDiagram
  papers ||--o{ questions : contains
  questions ||--|{ options : has
  questions ||--o{ assets : "stem / full crop"
  options ||--o{ assets : "option crop"
  chapters ||--|{ subtopics : has
  questions }o--o{ subtopics : "question_topics"
  questions ||--o| answers : keyed_by

  papers {
    text id PK "2012 | pp | sap"
    int year "nullable for pp/sap"
    text source "HKDSE MC"
  }

  questions {
    uuid id PK
    text paper_id FK
    int number "1..33"
    text statement "OCR / edited text"
    text layout_kind "text_only | stem_image | option_images | mixed"
    text full_png_path "output/year/qN.png"
  }

  options {
    uuid id PK
    uuid question_id FK
    text label "A|B|C|D"
    text body "may be empty if graph-only"
    bool is_correct
  }

  assets {
    uuid id PK
    uuid question_id FK
    uuid option_id FK "null for stem/full"
    text role "full_page | stem | option"
    text media_kind "diagram | graph | photo | other"
    text path "filesystem or object key"
    int bbox_x "optional crop box"
    int bbox_y
    int bbox_w
    int bbox_h
  }

  chapters {
    text id PK "Radiation"
    int sort_order
  }

  subtopics {
    text id PK
    text chapter_id FK
    text name "Photoelectric effect and photons"
  }

  question_topics {
    uuid question_id FK
    text subtopic_id FK
    bool is_primary
    int score "classifier score"
  }

  answers {
    uuid question_id PK
    text correct_option "A|B|C|D"
    real correct_pct "from answer key"
  }
```

### How the VT-graph question looks as rows

**Question** (e.g. “which option has the correct v–t graph?”)

| field | value |
|---|---|
| paper_id | `2024` |
| number | `12` |
| statement | `Which of the following is the correct v-t graph for ...` |
| layout_kind | `option_images` |
| full_png_path | `output/2024/q12.png` |

**Options**

| label | body | is_correct |
|---|---|---|
| A | `` | false |
| B | `` | true |
| C | `` | false |
| D | `` | false |

**Assets** (this is the important part)

| role | option | path | media_kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| full_page | - | `output/2024/q12.png` | diagram |
| option | A | `assets/2024/q12_A.png` | graph |
| option | B | `assets/2024/q12_B.png` | graph |
| option | C | `assets/2024/q12_C.png` | graph |
| option | D | `assets/2024/q12_D.png` | graph |

Stem-with-diagram (2024 Q1) would instead have `role=stem` once, and options keep text bodies with no option assets.

### Instance sketch (one question tree)

```text
Question 2024-Q15  [Wave Motion / Reflection...]
├── full_page: output/2024/q15.png
├── stem:      assets/2024/q15_stem.png   (ripple tank + L-barrier)
├── A: image   assets/2024/q15_A.png
├── B: image   assets/2024/q15_B.png
├── C: image   assets/2024/q15_C.png
├── D: image   assets/2024/q15_D.png
└── answer: A   correct_pct: 61.2
```

### Topic query later

```sql
SELECT q.paper_id, q.number, q.full_png_path
FROM questions q
JOIN question_topics qt ON qt.question_id = q.id
JOIN subtopics s ON s.id = qt.subtopic_id
WHERE s.chapter_id = 'Radiation'
  AND qt.is_primary = true
ORDER BY q.paper_id, q.number;
```

Or filter to photoelectric only via `s.name = 'Photoelectric effect and photons'`.

---

## Classification already in the repo

From `scripts/classify_by_topic.py`: 5 chapters, keyword-scored subtopics, usually 1 primary topic, optionally a second if scores are close.

### Heat and Gases
- Temperature and thermal equilibrium
- Specific heat capacity
- Latent heat and change of state
- Heat transfer processes
- Gas laws
- Kinetic theory of gases
- Internal energy and thermodynamics

### Force and Motion
- Kinematics
- Newtons laws and forces
- Moments and statics
- Momentum and collisions
- Work energy and power
- Projectile motion
- Circular motion
- Gravitation

### Wave Motion
- Wave properties and propagation
- Reflection refraction diffraction interference
- Sound
- Light reflection and refraction
- Lenses and optical instruments
- Wave nature of light
- Electromagnetic spectrum

### Electricity and Magnetism
- Electrostatics
- Electric circuits
- Electrical energy and domestic electricity
- Magnetic fields and motors
- Electromagnetic induction
- Alternating current and transformers

### Radiation
- Atomic models
- Radioactivity and nuclear radiation
- Nuclear reactions and binding energy
- X-rays and radiation applications
- Photoelectric effect and photons

That taxonomy maps 1:1 onto `chapters` / `subtopics` / `question_topics`.

---

## Practical storage advice

1. Keep images on disk (or object storage); DB stores **paths + crop boxes**, not blobs.
2. Always keep `full_page` from today’s segmentation; add stem/option crops only when needed.
3. `layout_kind` helps the UI decide whether to show text options vs option thumbnails.
4. Put classification in join tables, not only a single `chapter` column, so cross-topic questions stay queryable both ways.

If you want next step, I can turn this into concrete SQLite DDL + a loader from `output/` (and later OCR JSON) without implementing option cropping yet.
